When a response has a 4xx or 5xx status code, the error message is built by checking the `reason` attribute of the response. If `reason` is a bytes object, it attempts to decode it first using utf-8 encoding. If decoding fails, it falls back to iso-8859-1 encoding. The status code and the decoded or fallback reason string are then used to construct the error message. This is implemented in the `Response.raise_for_status` method [1].
